sources.snippet: We plan to contribute to AI safety by (1) maintaining a high safety bar-preventing misuse of our released models while maximizing users' freedom, (2) sharing best practices and recipes for how to build safe AI systems with the industry, and (3) accelerating external research on alignment by sharing code, datasets, and model specs.
